p.note: ometre. l. & item. D. Excuf. Tutor. Gabriel. tract. de jur. quaj, non aufer. Bronchorst. grant. I. ff. I. ~ 3.

main_text.p: Unde non aliter munus vel officium in a-iuem collatum revocari poterit, quam si qui illud suscepperat, se inutilem suâ culpâ, se illi muneri præbuerit. l. 2. Cod. de Prof. & Med. libr. 10. l. 8. Cod. eod. l. 6. §. 4. D. Excuf. Tutor. l. 12. Cod. de Dignit. libr. 12.

18. Quod si de successore Principis loquamur, immodica largitio privilegiorum à Prædecessore facta, præsertim eorum, quæ publicum jus spectant, omnino revocari poterit. Quod talis immoderata & irrationabilis concessio, reipublicæ sit perniciosa. c. ipsa pietas 23. q. 4. Bald. in l. jubemus. Cod. Sacros. Eccles.

19. Cæterum, in casibus præcedentibus, quod privilegia publicâ nitantur fide, successores, eodem modo, quo antecessores obstringuntur. Enench. 3. de Priv. c. 7. c. 11. n. 44. n. 60. Besold. delib. jur. ex libr. 1. D. p. 34. 43. de Privil. vid. Vaz. Barbos. Axiom. litt. G. n. 15. Raubar. quest. jur. 11. part. II. ibique varios.

page.notes: Marginal citations at the top left are partly damaged and cut by the binding shadow; readings such as "quaj," and "ometre" are doubtful. The marginal note on the first line is run into the text where it is hard to separate. The Greek/Latin reading of "in a-" line-end is taken as printed. The final "E" and "SE-" are a catchword-like signature line at the foot, printed as they stand.
